title: verify_patient_registration_validation
description: Test the patient registration API endpoint to ensure validation of CPF, email, and phone number is correctly enforced according to the validation criteria.

title: test_secure_authentication_and_access_control
description: Verify the authentication API endpoints to ensure secure login using JWT and Row Level Security (RLS) for proper access control.

title: validate_appointment_scheduling_notifications
description: Test the appointment scheduling API to confirm that automatic confirmation and notifications are sent via WhatsApp, SMS, and email upon booking.

title: test_clinical_document_generation_with_ai_support
description: Verify the clinical documentation API endpoints to ensure documents can be generated automatically and manually with AI assistance and are editable.

title: export_financial_and_clinical_reports
description: Test the report generation API endpoints to ensure financial and clinical reports can be exported correctly in PDF and Excel formats.

title: monitor_system_performance_and_uptime
description: Test the system health and monitoring API endpoints to verify performance metrics such as page load time under 2 seconds and uptime greater than 99.9%.

title: test_backup_and_recovery_processes
description: Verify the backup API endpoints to ensure daily automatic backups are performed and data recovery mechanisms are functional.

title: validate_responsive_accessibility_compliance
description: Test the user interface API endpoints to ensure the system is responsive and meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.

title: audit_log_tracking_and_compliance
description: Verify the audit API endpoints to ensure all user actions are logged properly for traceability and compliance with LGPD.

title: test_automated_reminder_sending_via_multiple_channels
description: Test the communication API endpoints to verify automated sending of reminders and confirmations through WhatsApp, SMS, and email with webhook response handling.
